notes.title: GnollHack Wiki Has Moved to a New Location
notes.content: [h2]GnollHack Wiki Has Moved[/h2][p]You can find GnollHack wiki now at:[/p][p][url="https://wiki.gnollhack.com/"]https://wiki.gnollhack.com/[/url][/p][p]The new wiki has the following upsides over the old one on GitHub:[/p][list][*][p]It's faster to use.[/p][/*][*][p]It doesn't fail to render pages.[/p][/*][*][p]It can be indexed by search engines.[/p][/*][*][p]It supports dashes in page titles.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Wiki Git Repository[/h2][p]The Git repository for the wiki now resides at:[/p][p][url="https://github.com/hyvanmielenpelit/GnollHackWiki"]https://github.com/hyvanmielenpelit/GnollHackWiki[/url][/p][p]This allows other people to fork the repository, make changes to the documentation, and make a pull request for the changes.[/p][h2]Editing Instructions[/h2][p]We have also compiled editing instructions for the wiki here:[/p][p][url="https://wiki.gnollhack.com/Editing%20Wiki%20with%20Visual%20Studio%20Code.md"]Editing Wiki with Visual Studio Code[/url][/p]

notes.title: Junethack
notes.content:
[h2]Summary[/h2]
GnollHack is part of Junethack, a cross-variant NetHack tournament, in June 2025.

[h2]Challenge[/h2]
Are you ready to embark on a perilous journey through the Dungeons of Doom? Ready to collect all the treasures their chthonic depths have to offer? Ready to kill all your enemies and EAT their corpses? Ready to challenge the mightiest demons of Gehennom and battle the mighty Wizard of Yendor? And BADASS enough to travel the Heavens themselves while kicking angels in the face?

Then take part in Junethack.

[h2]Schedule[/h2]
Junethack 2025 starts in [b]1 June, 2025[/b], and ends in [b]30 June, 2025[/b]. For the exact time zone when the tournament starts and ends, please refer to the Junethack website.

Registration starts a few days before the start of the event.

[h2]Junethack Website[/h2]
[url=https://junethack.net/]https://junethack.net/[/url]

[h2]Registration[/h2]
To be eligible to take part in Junethack:
[olist]
[*] Register a [b]GnollHack Account[/b] by using the Server Posting Setup button in the settings or visiting [url=https://account.gnollhack.com/]https://account.gnollhack.com/[/url].
[*] Register your [b]GnollHack Account user name[/b] to [url=https://junethack.net/]Junethack[/url], when registration is open.
[*] Register [b]Junethack user name[/b] in GnollHack Account.
[*] Enable [b]Tournament Mode[/b] in the settings.
[/olist]
